payload.campaign: string — the campaign's id; its next session, at the campaign's last position + 1, settled when it is applied. A oneshot that has its session takes no other (oneshot-single-session)
payload.title: string — the session's title, not blank
payload.plannedOn: string | null — optional, the day it is planned for, YYYY-MM-DD
payload.present: string[] — optional, the PCs ticked present, each a PC (« pj ») of the campaign (present-only-pj); none when absent
